question: How many orders are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many unique customers (people) are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers

question: How many sellers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers

question: How many orders have the status delivered?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question: How many orders were canceled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

question: How many orders are there for each order status?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question: Which payment type appears most often in the payment records?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average review score across all reviews, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) FROM order_reviews

question: How many reviews have a score of 1?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1

question: What is the total payment value across all payments, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) FROM order_payments

question: How many customer records are located in the state of SP?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP'

question: Which three states have the most sellers? List the state and the seller count, most first.
gold_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY n DESC, seller_state LIMIT 3

question: Which customer state has the most customer records?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, customer_state LIMIT 1

question: What is the average price of an order item, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM order_items

question: What is the highest price of any single order item?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items

question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'

question: How many orders were placed in November 2017?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017-11'

question: How many delivered orders arrived after their estimated delivery date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question: How many orders have no customer delivery date recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL

question: How many products have no category name?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

question: How many products are in the category 'perfumery' (English category name)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'perfumery'

question: What are the top 5 product categories (English names) by number of order items sold? Give the category and the count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY n DESC, t.product_category_name_english LIMIT 5

question: Which product category (English name) has the highest total item price sold?
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which seller has sold the most order items? Give the seller_id.
gold_sql: SELECT seller_id FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, seller_id LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 sellers by total item price sold? Give the seller_id and the total rounded to 2 decimals, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average freight value, rounded to 2 decimals, for order items in orders shipped to customers in the state RJ?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.freight_value), 2) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'

question: How many orders contain more than one order item?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: What is the average review score, rounded to 2 decimals, for delivered orders that arrived after their estimated delivery date?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date

question: How many unique customers (people) placed more than one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: What is the average number of installments for credit card payments, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

question: Which month number (1-12) of 2017 had the most orders placed?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS m FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY m ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer state has the highest total payment value?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were paid using more than one payment type?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1)

question: Among delivered orders that have a delivery date, what percentage arrived after the estimated delivery date? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What is the average number of days between purchase and customer delivery for delivered orders, rounded to 1 decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)), 1) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: Which product_id appears in the most order items?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, product_id LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct cities do customers live in?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_city) FROM customers

question: What is the weight in grams of the heaviest product?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(product_weight_g) FROM products

question: How many reviews include a comment message?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL

question: How many orders contain items from more than one seller?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1)
